# Play Music

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Start's playing the provided music.

## Syntax

~~~~text
playMusic(music: <#Variable#>, shuffle: <#Enumeration (WFPlayMusicActionShuffle) (Optional)#>, repeat: <#Enumeration (WFPlayMusicActionRepeat) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
playMusic(music: ShortcutInput, shuffle: Songs, repeat: One)
~~~~
